not_found_description: The link may be mistyped or may no longer exist.
load_error_description: Check your internet connection and try again.
route_error_description: We couldn't show this screen. Try again.
login_description: Pay on campus with your university email. We create your wallet the first time you sign in.
sol_balance_empty: You need SOL to pay the network fee.
sol_balance_low: You're running low on SOL for network fees.
pay_description: Scan the merchant's QR code or paste its link.
link_invalid: This link isn't a valid charge.
link_no_reference: This charge has no reference: the merchant couldn't confirm it.
link_memo: This charge includes a memo, which Uallet doesn't support.
scan_description: Point at the code the merchant shows.
scan_multiple_codes: There are several payment codes in view. Point at just one.
scan_error_insecure_context: The camera only works over a secure connection (HTTPS). Paste the link.
scan_error_permission_denied: Allow camera access in your browser or paste the link.
scan_error_no_camera: We couldn't find a camera. Paste the link.
scan_error_failed: Couldn't start the QR reader. Paste the link.
confirm_name_unverified: The merchant writes this name: it isn't verified.
confirm_already_paid: This charge is already paid. If you didn't pay it, ask the merchant for a new charge.
payment_in_progress: Wait for the payment to finish.
payment_failure_no_funds: You don't have enough balance for this payment.
payment_failure_no_sol: You don't have enough SOL for the network fee.
payment_failure_failed: The payment didn't go through. Try again.
payment_failure_unknown: We don't know whether the payment went through. Check your balance before trying again.
metrics_empty: Here you'll see how long the payments you make from this device take.
metrics_p95_hint: 95% of payments take this long or less
metrics_stage_prepare_hint: Build the transaction, fetch the blockhash and simulate it
metrics_stage_confirm_hint: Send it and wait for the network to confirm it
metrics_footnote: Measured on this device, from when you tap “Pay”. The last 50 payments are kept.
